message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815 near present‑day Belgium, resulted in roughly **23,000–24,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing, or captured) across all sides. Estimates vary slightly depending on the source:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition (Wellington & Blücher) | ~22,000 |

These figures combine killed, wounded, missing, and captured soldiers. For more precise breakdowns you might consult primary military reports from the period or modern scholarly compilations such as Digby Smith’s *The Napoleonic Wars Data Book* or the *Historical Dictionary of the Napoleonic Era*.
